name: Angola

flag.description: Two horizontal bands, red over black, with a yellow emblem in the centre: half a cogwheel crossed by a machete, with a five-pointed star.
flag.symbolism: Red stands for the blood shed during the liberation struggle, black for Africa and yellow for the country's wealth; the cogwheel represents industrial workers, the machete peasants and armed struggle, and the star progress.

hook: Angola's red-over-black flag carries a yellow half-cogwheel and machete in the middle, an African take on the hammer and sickle.
trivia: A new flag showing a rock-painting-style sun was proposed in 2003, but it was never adopted.
Luanda has several times been ranked the world's most expensive city for expatriates.
Angola, one of Africa's largest oil producers, left OPEC at the start of 2024.
